accounting: Returned-usage public-rate estimates, not invoices; 19 prior unknown-cost attempts are retained. CPU/controller effort not priced as provider fees.

archive_format_diagnostic.scope: Post-study comparison of standard gzip level 6 and xz preset 6 on one identical tar of actual records-A research evidence. Not a randomized end-to-end research-speed experiment; no provider calls. Apply a smaller standard archive format only after full decompressed tar hash equality. Preserve every selected original file.

capacity_diagnostic.scope: After-observation, read-only capacity diagnosis. Reconstruct only the exact four report/proposal records requested in cycle five; verify complete old records unchanged and exact 24KiB historical snapshot reproduction. 32KiB is the existing default cap, while the trial explicitly selected 24KiB and page size 4 (default page size is 16). This is not a rerun of an entire default configuration or proof of model improvement. No provider calls or source edits.

elapsed_measurement: Monotonic first native initialization to final heldout-selected closure, includes manual reviews, inter-project waiting and diagnostics during study; excludes earlier harness/input authoring. Development first gain is not a heldout confirmation time. No paired full-workflow speed claim.
limitations: Finite holdout and supplementary adaptive boundary checks are not universal correctness. Noise winners failed at the 65536-byte record before reaching the many-record recursion case.

Frozen plan and rules overstate fresh namespace as preventing all encoder state reuse. Imported modules could share state; manually reviewed actual programs use no such channel. Fresh controller process independently decoded heldout archives.
Environment details were captured during cycle 3, not as a complete before-first-call environment manifest.

No product code/default change in this study. Trial explicitly set 24KiB/4-record paging; counterfactual 32KiB capacity packing is not a full default-configuration rerun or demonstrated model improvement.

runtime_api_diagnostic.scope: Post-study reproduction. The original prompt omitted interpreter version. No model code was repaired.

scope: Exploratory 2 data conditions x memory off/on x 6 cycles, one pair per condition. Actual code research, no product-source changes. Seeded zlib reference is not the strongest standard-library baseline. No memory reuse observed, no causal or general memory/efficiency claim.

supplementary_standard_reference.scope: Post-study supplementary reference, motivated by limited seeded zlib baseline. Two standard-library substitutions of the exact original framing/decoder. No model calls, no reselection, no new research feedback. Independently compute development and holdout full archive costs; do not rewrite the primary baseline or claim these were preregistered. Manual source review: struct length framing and standard lzma/bz2 only, no I/O/state/network.
